cases.title: a temporary vote carries its node's fee, and a zero fee when the node charges nothing
a permanent request whose temporary votes require fees is refused without a fee block
a fee block paying each representative its fee gets a permanent vote without a fee, on one block more than the temporary votes
a fee block with fewer payments than the votes that require one is refused
a fee paid one short is refused
a fee paid one over is refused: the amount must match exactly
a fee paid in another token is refused
a fee paid to another account than the voter is refused
fees paid in another order than the votes get a permanent vote
a payer that can afford its send but not the fees as well is refused for its balance
two fee blocks are refused for that in a temporary request, and for their block count in a permanent one
a fee block that is not the last block of a permanent request is an ordinary block, so the request lacks the fee block its votes require
fees with a zero option are optional: a permanent request without a fee block is given
optional fees paid to every representative, each matching an option, get a permanent vote
optional fees paid to only some representatives are refused: a fee block pays all of them or only the required ones
optional fees paid to every representative in an amount no option names are refused
with one free node, a fee block paying only the required fees gets a permanent vote
with one free node, a fee block that also pays the free node must match its zero fee, and is refused for paying one
fees offered in two tokens may all be paid in the dearer token
fees offered in two tokens may be paid in either token, chosen per representative
fees with a payee are paid to the payee, once per vote
fees with a payee need only some SEND matching each vote: a fee block of the right size with one SEND to the payee serves every vote
fees with a payee paid to the voters instead are refused
a quote carries its node's fee and is valid for five minutes, with the minute of slop parsing allows
a vote on a quote carries the quote's fee, not the one its node charges now
a quote on a block that overspends is refused: a quote validates the outcome
a quote on a block that is no successor is given, though a vote is refused
a quote on a block whose idempotent key a published block holds is given, though a vote is refused
a quote on a block competing with one this node voted for is given, though a vote is refused
a permanent request without this node's temporary vote and without the fee block its votes require is refused for the fee block
a fee one short paid by a payer that cannot afford its send and the fees is refused for the fee before the balance
